title: X-LAB RT8 frameset specification
notes: Official mainland RT8 frameset page for a climbing road frame of Toray T800 high-modulus carbon: 650 g for a bare-carbon, unpainted size-M frame excluding fork and seatpost; the frameset includes a carbon integrated handlebar (360×80 to 400×120 mm by size) and a 300 mm carbon seatpost; carbon fork with 12×100 mm thru-axle and flat-mount brakes; four sizes XS–L whose published geometry table matches the RT9 table (stack/reach XS 510/362, S 525/372, M 543/384, L 567/396 mm). Listed at CNY 9,980. No maximum tire clearance is stated.
